items.title: File Widerspruch against Gefahrklasse classification
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Document date (posting day) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated so the printed Bescheid date is used as posting day. The letter states the Bescheid counts as bekannt gegeben (delivered) on the 4th day after posting, matching the post-2025 rule (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies, as a Berufsgenossenschaft is a social-law body, not a tax office, so the delivery day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday). Counting 4 calendar days after 19.11.2026: 20.11, 21.11, 22.11, 23.11 → delivery/Bekanntgabe = Monday 23.11.2026. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), the day of delivery is not counted; the one-month Widerspruch period runs from 24.11.2026 and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
